events.label: approach

CMC.limitation: Plane intersects actual polygons; convex enclosure includes voids and cannot alone prove local volume acceptance.

MCP.limitation: Plane intersects actual polygons; convex enclosure includes voids and cannot alone prove local volume acceptance.

IP.limitation: Plane intersects actual polygons; convex enclosure includes voids and cannot alone prove local volume acceptance.

limitations: Transverse test excludes tangent/coplanar/adjacent folds; zero never means visual acceptance.
Short edge ratio inflation must be compared with absolute deformation and actual rendered silhouette.
